qualification.details: Project Trainee: B.Sc. / 3 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology. Experience in civil engineering lab work desired. Research Associate – I (Postdoctoral Researcher): PhD in engineering or science from a recognized university. Prior exposure to research in the field of structural health monitoring, fatigue, data acquisition, and interpretation of data from sensors used in civil engineering is required. Research Associate – I (Postdoctoral Researcher): PhD in engineering or science from a recognized university. Strong computational background (including programming) is required. Prior exposure to research in the field of quantum algorithms and applied engineering is desired. Senior Research Fellow: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course; Qualified in CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, or other national-level examinations. Degree in Civil/Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering and allied areas is required. Prior exposure to non-destructive testing and instrumentation will be a bonus.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IISc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IISc Recruitment 2026 is 13 October 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for various positions including Project Trainee, Research Associate, and Senior Research Fellow at the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IISc posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for these positions is strictly via email. Candidates must send their application in PDF format to the official email address provided in the notification with the correct subject line.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the IISc Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply for these positions free of cost.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Research Associate – I (Postdoctoral Researcher) position will receive a monthly salary of ₹58,000 plus HRA as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for IISc recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves two main stages: shortlisting of candidates based on their educational qualifications and experience, followed by an interview which may be conducted either online or in-person.

faq.question: Q7. Can a B.Sc graduate apply for the Project Trainee post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates holding a B.Sc degree or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology are eligible to apply for the Project Trainee position at IISc Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q8. Is prior experience required for these positions?
faq.answer: Yes, specific research experience is desired or required for different posts. For example, experience in civil engineering lab work is desired for the Project Trainee, while research exposure is required for Research Associate roles.

faq.question: Q9. When is the interview scheduled for these posts?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 24 October 2026. Candidates should keep track of their emails for further communication regarding the interview process.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should be attached with the email application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach a cover letter, their updated curriculum vitae (CV), copies of academic qualifications, and proof of age in a single PDF file when sending the application via email.
